messages.author: 66e1e26c5f2ad084
messages.subject: gmulmix abundance and formating question
parts:
Hi I am having some issues formatting an unmarkedFrameGMM for use in
the gmultmix function and had a question about the latent transect
level abundance estimate.
I have 83 1x1 km square grids (sites) with 16 points per grid which I
am treating as my primary periods and at each point, we conducted a
six minute point count. Within each point count we identified each
minute interval to use the removal method which I am treating as my
secondary periods. The matrix for the observed data (y) are 16 points
with each point having 6, one minute intervals, 96 columns in the
observation matrix. The observation level covariates also have 96
columns. My siteCovs are elevation at each site, one column, and
Julian date are my primary period variables, 16 columns.
I get the following error “invalid class unmarkedFrame" object:
obsCovData does not have M*obsNum rows”, I checked to see if the
number of rows and columns in the detection matrix matched the number
in the obsCovData and it does. I probably overlooked something simple
but am at a loss.
My question with regards to abundance is that I am assuming the
abundance estimate is at the transect (site) level but was not sure.
When I run a constant model for oven bird, without any covariates I
get an estimate of 1.07 per grid/site (1kmx1km square) which seems
low but if the estimate was at the point level then that would seem
reasonable.
backTransform(oven1, type="lambda")
Estimate SE LinComb (Intercept)
1.07 0.156 0.0688 1

thanks for any help with this issue.

Rob Sparks

messages.author: df74d6fccec2ff7e
messages.subject: Re: [unmarked] gmulmix abundance and formating question
parts:
Hi Rob,

Have you seen the help page for unmarkedFrameGMM? It shows how to format the data when you have each of the covariate types. If it does not clear things up, could you post a reproducible example that returns the error?

The abundance estimate is the number of ovenbirds/point.

There will be some documentation corrections and updates in the next release.

Richard
